replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Greetings, Illultivar.

You've remained banned for a long enough period of time, so I'll be lifting your punishment and allowing you back in the server. Hopefully the lesson has been learned and you won't have to appeal once again. Abiding by the rules is all you gotta do to avoid getting in trouble. Having said this, welcome back to the server and have fun.

Sincerely,
- timaeusTestified | Senior Moderator
